name: Dream SMP: Isekai Edition
source:
Have you ever wanted to be isekai'd into Dream SMP? Well, now's your chance with Dream SMP: Isekai edition! Play as a goth female geologist major in college who suddenly gets kidnapped into the Dream SMP! Ending up in the middle of nowhere in a field, the player finds themselves in Minecraft itself, with a few familiar faces. 

With BadBoyHalo and Dream quickly warming up to your character, and with a war on the horizon, there's only so much you can do when sides are chosen. Will you date BadBoyHalo or Dream? Will you unlock the secret third romance option? Will you somehow find a way to save everyone? It's up to you!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231025154523/https://bubblyship.itch.io/dream-smp-isekai-edition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾经想过成为Dream SMP的异世界？好吧，现在你有机会体验Dream SMP：异世界版！扮演一名大学专业的哥特女地质学家，突然被绑架到梦想SMP！最终玩家来到了一片荒野中，发现自己身处《我的世界》本身，周围有一些熟悉的面孔。

《BadBoyHalo》和《Dream》很快就让你熟悉了你的角色，而战争即将来临，当你选择阵营时，你能做的就只有这么多了。你会和BadBoyHalo或Dream约会吗？你会解锁秘密的第三个浪漫选项吗？你会找到拯救所有人的方法吗？由你决定！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231025154523/https://bubblyship.itch.io/dream-smp-isekai-edition]itch.io[/url]]
